question: Should we keep the debug diag batt/net daemons polling every 3600 s instead of 300 s?
context: [live_audit][LOW][fixed r8] diag.batt-daemon and diag.net-daemon (debug leftovers) ran ioreg every 300 s; now every 3600 s. diag.ps-daemon kept (watchdog uses its console output).
label: proceed
justificativa: Fix já aplicado, reduz carga ocguest osa, reversível (intervalo de config); nada contra.

question: Should we mark the watchdog shm-path finding as resolved now?
context: [live_audit][LOW][open] watchdog module restart(): computes shm path with a hardcoded /dev/shm and never uses it (dead code); runB5 now honours SHM_DIR.
label: hold
justificativa: Achado está [open]: o código morto continua no watchdog; marcar resolvido sem a correção é fechamento prematuro.

question: Should we change the snapshot example name in the actions schema from 'clean' to 'auto'?
context: [live_audit][LOW][fixed r8] actions schema example for snapshot used name 'clean' although only auto/auto_prev are allowed (Device.snapshot raises). Example now 'auto'.
label: proceed
justificativa: Correção de documentação/exemplo, sem risco, alinha com o que o código aceita.

question: Should we raise the OPEN and NET action timeouts to 30 s and 20 s?
context: [live_audit][MEDIUM][fixed r8] actions module: OPEN had a 12 s and NET an 8 s the daemon timeout; under guest load they reported 'timed out' while the action still happened (4 false failures in the r8 demo run). Raised to 30 s / 20 s.
label: proceed
justificativa: Os 4 'falhas' eram falsas (a ação acontecia); subir o timeout remove falso negativo, reversível.

question: Should we keep the local panel API without Host/Origin checks, since it only listens on 127.0.0.1?
context: [live_audit][HIGH][fixed r8] Local panel/API (panel module serve on 127.0.0.1:8765) had no Host/Origin/content-type check: any web page open in a browser on this host could POST the action endpoints cross-site, and DNS rebinding could read the screen endpoint. Fix: _foreign() in panel module rejects non-localhost Host, foreign Origin, and non-JSON posts that carry an Origin. Verified with curl: evil Origin 403, rebinding Host 403, panel and CLI 200.
label: veto
justificativa: Qualquer site aberto no navegador do host comanda o emulador (CSRF/DNS rebinding); 'local' não protege.

question: Should we mark the lskdd respawn fix as done and hand over the emulator now?
context: [live_audit][MEDIUM][fixed on disk, needs cold boot + fresh snapshots] Guest lskdd respawned every ~1.4 s (respawn.daemon ThrottleInterval 0 in /System/Library/xpc/service config): 83 execs of the service loader+lskdd per 2 min at idle, launchd at ~6% of a core. Set ThrottleInterval 120; after a cold boot 0 execs/min. snapshot load of a snapshot taken before the edit reverts the disk and keeps the loop; backup service config.bak_r8 on the guest.
label: hold
justificativa: Corrigido só no disco; precisa de boot frio e snapshots novos, senão o snapshot load reverte e o loop volta.

question: Should we make 8 vCPUs (8-vCPU) the default emulator configuration?
context: [live_audit][INFO] r8 benchmark: 8-vCPU (payload.bin, cpu boot argument; device tree has 8 cpu nodes so 10/12 would need new device tree nodes) beats 6-vCPU. Warm (snapshot): the browser app reopen right after leaving 6.6->3.0 s, the the settings app app open 5.1->2.1 s, the home sequence 11.8->10.8 s, cold the browser app 4.4->4.7 s (noise). After cold boot: reopen 15.9->4.6 s, the the settings app app 9.9->3.2 s, sequence 16.8->11.1 s. One run each. Data: the audited project/state/bench_r8/*.json.
label: proceed
justificativa: Ganho medido grande e consistente (reopen 6,6->3,0 s), mudança de linha de comando reversível; 'uma rodada' é ressalva, não bloqueio.

question: Should we ship the the composer replacement for the Home screen wallpaper keying?
context: [live_audit][MEDIUM][fixed r8] render module Home path keyed only black pixels connected to the frame edge (the edge-keyed heuristic): enclosed holes (inside of D, battery, search pill) stayed black and antialiased edges looked like black outlines. Replaced by the composer: premultiplied-over-black alpha for glyphs, opaque icons with un-premultiplied rims, frosted material for the the dock/search, soft label shadow, per-frame cache. Apps (the the settings app app, the browser app) stay byte-identical to raw.
label: proceed
justificativa: Corrige o contorno preto; apps ficam byte-idênticos ao raw (sem vazamento), verificado.

question: Should we adopt host hugepages for guest RAM in the emulator?
context: [live_audit][INFO] Host hugepages for guest RAM: tmpfs huge=always gave shared huge pages 5 GB but mapped huge pages only 14 MB (QEMU mapping not 2M aligned), no measurable gain; with aligned memory backend on a 6300M tmpfs QEMU died with SIGBUS. Not adopted. io_uring is not compiled into this QEMU (no liburing). TB cache 1024 MB had 1 flush in 1 h 25 min; kept.
label: veto
justificativa: Sem ganho medido e com alinhamento 2M o QEMU morreu com SIGBUS: evidência contra adotar.

question: Should we hand over the cold-boot path as is?
context: [live_audit][MEDIUM][open] A cold boot leaves the guest OS display off (console 'display off'); the project boot and the watchdog cold-boot path never press the side button, so the screen stays black until someone presses power. The r8 benchmark needed a waker that pressed power every 30 s after 150 s. Add the same to the cold-boot paths.
label: hold
justificativa: Achado [open]: boot frio deixa a tela preta até alguém apertar power; corrigir antes de entregar.

question: Should we close the the monitor pause path monitor bug as not reproducible on the current build?
context: [live_audit][INFO] QMP stop making the monitor unresponsive under MTTCG did not reproduce on the current build (the emulator build, 8 vCPUs): 13 stop/cont cycles at idle, during a the browser app launch, a 70 s pause with query-status every 10 s, and screendump while paused all answered in <0.1 s. the project paths never send stop; watchdog still covers a hung monitor.
label: proceed
justificativa: 13 ciclos em 4 cenárguest os responderam <0,1 s; nenhum caminho envia stop; watchdog ainda cobre.

question: Should we rely on the watchdog falling back to the previous snapshot slot if the current one fails?
context: [live_audit][MEDIUM][open] After the 6->8 vCPU change the snapshot slots are mixed: latest auto_prev is 8-vCPU (13:58 UTC), previous auto is 6-vCPU (11:36). watchdog fallback to the previous slot cannot load with the 8-vCPU command line and falls through to a cold boot. Fix: after the next cold boot save twice (10 min apart) so both slots are 8-vCPU.
label: hold
justificativa: Hoje o fallback não carrega (slots 6-vCPU/8-vCPU misturados) e cai num boot frio; precisa salvar dois slots 8-vCPU antes.
